findingDetails.title: The Aside installer digest gate is enforced only by scripts/install.sh and documented nowhere, while seventeen documentation sites present the ungated vendor curl pipe bash as the install path
findingDetails.scopeProof: The gate is one block in one script and the omission is one sentence in one README row. rg for digest or sha256 over the Aside packet returns only scripts/install.sh, so no doc states the control; rg for the vendor installer URL returns seventeen sites across ten files, so the ungated path is the one the docs lead with. The Bladebro packet is unaffected.

results.summary: Goal criteria 1 through 6 hold on the shipped files. Criterion 7 is unverified because validate.sh is banned by the write surface and writes outside the lineage.
Phase 015 criteria 1 and 2 hold as behaviour from iteration 5. Criterion 3 replay half is the same unexecutable validate.sh item.

All six active findings re-read at their shipped file:line and all six are still active. R2-P1-001 scope confirmed at exactly two lines; R1-P2-001 and R4-P2-001 confirmed as one README release surface.

noveltyJustification: Weighted new = 1 (one P2). Weighted total = 1 new + 14 carried (two P1 at 5 each, four P2 at 1 each) = 15. Ratio 1/15 = 0.0667. The finding is new: no prior iteration compared the Aside wrapper digest gate against the docs that never mention it.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: cross-reference pass re-reading six active findings and comparing a code control against the documentation set that omits it

targetSelection.selectionReason: The cross-reference pass re-reads every active finding at its shipped file:line and then tests whether each finding scope is wider than recorded, which is what surfaced the undocumented digest gate
omittedHighRiskTargets: the Aside packet benchmark reports, excluded from every sweep in this lineage
the Bladebro and Chrome installers beyond the digest-ordering check

searchLedger.hypothesis: A supply-chain control may exist in code and be absent from the docs that describe the same script

searchActions.queryOrPath: rg -n "digest|sha256" over the Aside packet, then read scripts/README.md install.sh row
searchActions.result: only scripts/install.sh mentions the digest; scripts/README.md:55 describes the wrapper without it; the vendor URL appears at seventeen sites across ten files

searchLedger.rationale: The strongest control is invisible at the point of install and the docs lead with the ungated path

searchLedger.hypothesis: The Node 18 fix may be one instance of a fleet-wide Node version drift

searchActions.queryOrPath: rg -n "nvm install 1[0-9]|nvm use 1[0-9]" and a Node version sweep across the hub
searchActions.result: the nvm pattern appears at exactly two lines in one block; the Node 14 sites are all Bladebro launcher requirements and the Node 20 sites all Chrome bdg requirements

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: each packet states its own correct requirement, so the finding does not widen

searchLedger.hypothesis: Two findings on the same surface may be one remediation workstream

searchActions.queryOrPath: read README.md:8 and README.md:64-76 against ls changelog/
searchActions.result: the README claims 1.1.4.0 with no changelog entry and omits 1.1.2.0 and 1.1.3.0 which do exist

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: both are real defects but one edit fixes both, so they merge as a workstream rather than as a finding
searchLedger.rationale: The release surface is wrong in both directions

searchLedger.hypothesis: The ungated vendor command may be recommended without operator consent

searchActions.queryOrPath: read every install site for a consent gate
searchActions.result: INSTALL-GUIDE.md:21 says with my confirmation, SKILL.md:75 says let the operator decide, scripts/README.md:21 says only when an operator runs it deliberately

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: consent is gated everywhere; only the digest disclosure is missing
searchLedger.rationale: The defect is disclosure, not consent

title: The Aside installer digest gate is enforced only by scripts/install.sh and documented nowhere, while seventeen documentation sites present the ungated vendor curl pipe bash as the install path
scopeProof: The gate is one block in one script and the omission is one sentence in one README row. rg for digest or sha256 over the Aside packet returns only scripts/install.sh, so no doc states the control; rg for the vendor installer URL returns seventeen sites across ten files, so the ungated path is the one the docs lead with. detail: P2 kept: the digest gate exists in code and is documented nowhere, and the docs lead with the ungated vendor command. Consent is gated everywhere, so the defect is disclosure rather than an unsafe recommendation.

direction: The Node 14 and Node 20 requirements contradict each other across the hub
reason: they belong to different packets with different launchers and each is consistent inside its own packet

direction: The Aside packet recommends an ungated install without operator consent
reason: every install site frames it as an explicit operator decision

direction: The Bladebro installer has the same undisclosed-control gap
reason: its install guide and reference both state the Node prerequisite and its digest ordering was verified in iteration 2

direction: R2-P1-001 widens to the whole hub
reason: the nvm install 18 pattern appears at exactly two lines inside one Chrome troubleshooting block

direction: The run has converged to a pass
reason: two P1 findings remain active, so the verdict stays CONDITIONAL
